access_boundary: This record represents the July 2025 Codestral 25.08 release served as the codestral-2508 API model (and the Codestral alias that currently resolves to it). The retired codestral-2501 API line, the Codestral-22B-v0.1 weight release, Codestral Embed, and the Mistral API platform itself are separate boundaries.
strengths: First-party docs pin the release with an API model ID, a GA status, and the fill-in-the-middle endpoint
Dated release, structured outputs, function calling, and batch support are listed on one docs page
tradeoffs: No downloadable weights exist anywhere first-party for this line
No scrutable license grant of any kind; commercial terms govern entirely, and the docs page states no deprecation horizon
